summary.text: Joy C. Springer is serving her third term in the Arkansas House, representing District 76, which includes a portion of Pulaski County; she was first elected in a special election on March 4, 2020.

paragraphs.text: She previously worked as office manager and paralegal for John W. Walker, P.A., and served on the Little Rock School District Board of Education.
She holds a B.S. in business administration from Henderson State University, a B.S. in elementary education and a master's in education administration from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock.
